description: React component 'Analytics' which manages tabbed views for displaying performance data through various charts and breakdowns. It imports mock data, chart components, and utility functions for data formatting. The component renders different charts based on selected tabs, such as performance trends, platform distribution, device and demographic breakdowns, and geographic performance.

methods.name: renderTabContent
methods.description: Renders the content for the active tab based on the current state. Displays different chart components and breakdowns for performance, platforms, demographics, and geography.
